sources.title: meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Dense 29.6B vision-language model with a ViT-G/14 perception encoder and 128K context, distilled from Muse Spark for local agentic use. Emits channel-scoped reasoning and XML-style ATEM tool calls rather than JSON, so it needs the dedicated `muse_glimmer` tool-call and reasoning parsers.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer — Meta's 30B AI Model for Your Laptop
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer is Meta's 30-billion-parameter open-weight AI model, released on August 10, 2026. Unlike every other frontier model that needs a data center or a cloud API, Muse Glimmer was designed from the ground up to run on a single consumer GPU — your laptop's RTX 4060, your desktop's Radeon RX 7900, or an AMD Ryzen AI Max+ with unified memory.
